title: One Tree, Eleven Winters
subtitle: 森林生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 森林生态（自然生态·森林与生态）
meta: 主题语境：森林生态（自然生态·森林与生态）　|　核心词汇：wood　|　正文 298 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 wood 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: The ① wood for the table came from one tree, cut in 1961, and my grandfather said a table made of one tree is a table that will never split, and it never has. The ② wood behind the house is eleven acres and was planted in 1931, and he walked in it every Sunday for thirty-one years and never once carried anything out of it.
In the winter of 1963 the ③ wood ran out — eleven weeks of frost — and he cut the hedge instead, and the wood was never dry, and my grandmother said the hedge never forgave him and neither did she.

He was ④ in the woods by seven every morning in summer, before the yard, and he said the reason was the birds and not the walking. In 1974, after the operation, the doctor said he was not ⑤ out of the woods yet, and my grandmother said the doctor had plainly never met him.

The ⑥ wood carving above the door is eleven inches and took him eleven winters, and he said he was not making it, he was taking it out. He never owned a ⑦ wood, by which I mean a golf club, and he said a game in which you walk eleven hundred metres to hit a ball was invented by somebody with too much land.

The ⑧ wood smoke from that house could be smelled eleven fields away, and my mother says she could tell the time of day by it. The ⑨ wood of the table, which I have now, is eleven feet long and has one knot in it. The ⑩ wood, meaning the eleven acres behind the house, was sold in 1998 and cut in 1999, and the wood has not grown back, and there is a photograph of it and nothing else.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: E. 固定搭配：in the woods 在树林里
F. 固定搭配：out of the woods 脱离困境／危险
G. 固定搭配：wood carving 木雕
H. 固定搭配：wood smoke 柴烟；木柴燃烧的烟

items.q: The wood for the table came from one tree
The wood behind the house is eleven acres
the wood ran out, eleven weeks of frost
He was in the woods by seven
he was not out of the woods yet
The wood carving above the door
He never owned a wood, by which I mean
The wood smoke from that house
The wood of the table, which I have now
The wood, meaning the eleven acres

answers.why: the wood 意为“木料、木头”，做这张桌子的木料来自一棵树，1961 年砍的。
the wood 意为“树林、林地”，屋后那片树林有十一英亩，是 1931 年种的。
the wood 意为“木柴、柴火”，1963 年冬天柴火用完了——十一周的霜冻。
in the woods 意为“在树林里”，夏天他每天早上七点前就在树林里了。
out of the woods 意为“脱离困境、脱离危险”，1974 年手术后医生说他还未脱离危险。
wood carving 意为“木雕”，门上方那件木雕有十一英寸，花了他十一个冬天。
a wood 意为“（高尔夫球的）木杆”，他从来没有过一根木杆，也就是高尔夫球杆。
wood smoke 意为“柴烟、木柴燃烧的烟”，那栋房子的柴烟在十一块田外都闻得到。
the wood of the table 意为“这张桌子的木料”，如今在我手上的这张桌子长十一英尺，有一个节疤。
the wood 意为“树林”，屋后那十一英亩的树林 1998 年被卖掉，1999 年被砍光。
